items.question: What are the prescribed eye-counts for the navel and testicles in this iconographic scheme?
premises: Navel is measured by two eyes.
items.inference: The verse assigns a two-eye measure to both the navel and the testicles.
uncertainties: Exact ritual referent of netra as a unit remains unclear.
items.plain_english: The navel is measured by two eyes; the testicles are considered two-eyed.
